subject: Re: iMerit BiWeekly Sync Notes
text:
Hi Abinash,

Thanks for reaching out, here is my best understanding of the answers to
your questions.

   - *Overwrite Logic:* Team checked their review tasks and found only 1
   classification done by any one surgeon can only be approved. If the same
   'Task label' by another surgeon is being approved, then it automatically
   asks to 'Overwrite' the earlier approved label. What is the recommended
   minimum threshold for approving labels to avoid this overwrite scenario?
   - If both annotators created an acceptable annotation, go ahead and
      accept both and overwrite the second label.  The reviewer should also be
      able to edit the annotation before final submission.  From a
      workflow perspective, the main thing that matters is that the final label
      looks good.  The reject tool is used if the label is incorrect
or it would
      be desirable for the original labeler to review the label so they can
      improve their annotations.
   - *Multiple Start/End Points:* Team is finding it difficult to manage
   tasks with numerous start and end points within a single video (e.g., 10-20
   different timelines for the same task within a 30-minute video). The tool
   doesn't allow us to disagree on only one or two specific timelines without
   rejecting the entire task. Similarly, when disagreements between surgeons
   exist on only a few time points, approving the task becomes challenging.
   How can we effectively handle these scenarios?
   - This may be a limitation of the tool and we may need to change the
      workflow to make it easier to review.  In the future, we should probably
      make different segments different entries in the timeline so they can be
      labeled individually.  For now, the reviewer can accept the
closest one and
      the edit the label to be correct before final submission.
   - *Encord Team Assistance:* We would greatly appreciate the Encord
   team's availability this week to help us resolve these review workflow
   q
